purpose: After the selected IR-IVM N_F=9990 arc-length-500 result has a PASS audit, run the zero-OpenMM selector to freeze only the ODE--NEB retained path or paths needed for a threshold-targeted comparison.

required_inputs_after_selected_run_finis.already_paid_force_receipts: nine sealed ODE--NEB milestone receipts exist at N_F=30,240,480,990,2040,4080,6150,8160,9990; the N_F=6150 receipt is a rejected trial and must be excluded from the retained-path I_perp ledger, leaving eight exact retained-path milestones

recommended_economical_mode.forbidden_claim: exact first passage while any earlier distinct retained path is unmeasured

exact_mode.rule: densify distinct retained paths in chronological paid-N_F order, reusing rejected-batch duplicates by exact path hash, until every path before the first passing path is covered
exact_mode.warning: Because densified Delta E is not assumed monotone, exact certification can require many paths and in the no-passage case requires all 284 distinct retained paths.

metric_contract.densified_Delta_E: 500 energy evaluations at uniform Cartesian arc length on the frozen piecewise-linear 32-image path, including both endpoints
